t: 5:45 AM. The alarm. Call time is 7:30 for the trio.
o: Water + a real breakfast (eggs, toast, fruit)
Fuel that lasts.
Just a granola bar in the car
You'll be hungry by 9.
Skip it, too nervous
Nerves eat energy. Your body needs food more, not less.

t: Packing check. Your dance bag is by the door.
o: Open it and check every dance's shoes and costume
Found it: the trio tights were missing. Crisis averted.
Mom packed it, it's fine
Probably fine. Probably.
Grab it and go, we're late
Halfway there you remember the hairspray. In the bathroom.

t: You find the PITCH girls in the dressing room. Mia is crying — she can't find her earrings.
o: Help her look, then lend her a spare pair
Teammate. She'll dance better, and so will you.
Say 'they'll turn up' and keep doing your bun
Your bun is great. Mia is still crying.
Panic with her
Now two people can't find earrings.

t: Two hours until you're on. A whole team of older dancers is warming up on the side stage.
o: Proper warm-up, then mark the solo once with eyes UP
Warm, focused, ready.
Watch the older team the whole time
They're amazing. You forgot to warm up.
Run the solo full-out four times
You just danced a whole competition in the hallway.

t: Backstage, 3 numbers away. Your heart is going fast.
o: Breathe in for 4, out for 4. Say your cue: point, straighten, eyes up
Calm. Ready.
Check your phone
Someone posted a puppy. You lost your counts.
Ask everyone if they're nervous too
Everyone is. Now everyone's talking about it.

t: The vending machine backstage has ONE thing left. Everyone is staring at it.
o: Split the pretzels with the PITCH girls
Six dancers, one bag, zero drama. Legendary.
Buy the giant blue slushie
Blue tongue. In photos. Forever.
Nothing, you're fine
Your stomach disagrees loudly during the quiet part of the lyrical solo.

t: A famous choreographer from the convention walks past the dressing room.
o: Say hi and ask one real question about her class
She remembers you on Sunday. That's how scholarships happen.
Scream quietly and hide
Relatable. She waves anyway.
Ask for a selfie
Selfie achieved. Counts, forgotten.

t: GLITTER EMERGENCY. Ava opened the loose glitter. It's on everything. Including Mia.
o: Tape roll to the rescue, one costume at a time
Twenty minutes, zero glitter on stage. Hero.
Embrace it — we are a sparkly team now
The judges' comment sheet literally says 'so much glitter.' Not clear if good.
Blame Ava loudly
Ava cries. Now there's glitter AND tears.

t: Hallway dance battle! A team from another studio is doing 8-counts at each other. They point at you.
o: Jump in with your best 8 from the jazz group
The hallway loses its mind. New friends from Studio Blaze.
Cheer for both sides and stay warm
Smart. Warm legs, happy hallway.
Do the aerial you haven't landed
Hand touched. In the HALLWAY. It's on someone's story.
Dance it exactly like Sunday's filmed run, and hold the ending until the music is gone
The judges write a lot.
Try the aerial you haven't landed yet
You touched a hand down. It's what they remember.
Rush the ending to get off stage
The music was still playing when you left.
